action_items: None blocking. Optional: timer-add-package inline link ([data-testid=timer-add-package]) is wired correctly in TimerBar.jsx but hard to reach via UI because backend now always auto-creates an engagement on client creation — the link only surfaces if an admin later removes/deactivates all engagements. critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/timetrack.py update_client/update_engagement return docs via find_one without NO_ID projection on lines 102 & 118 — risk of ObjectId being returned (motor adds _id post-update). Add NO_ID projection. (Carried over from iteration_4 — still unfixed.)
No DELETE endpoints for coaching_clients or client_engagements — test data accumulates (TEST_UIG2* clients remain in DB after cleanup).
TimerBar.jsx line 47 fetches full /admin/clients list for every keystroke in search — no server-side ?q= param; fine at small scale but O(N) over the network per keypress.
AdminTime.jsx: 'profitability' endpoint is re-fetched together with entries on every filter change (useEffect on filters) — profitability does not depend on filters and could be fetched once.
create_client auto-engagement uses `now_iso()[:10]` for start_date but inserts without reading pkg hours_included consistency check — acceptable.
list_entries date_from/date_to filter is done in Python (post-fetch) over up to 2000 rows — fine now, consider pushing into Mongo query for scale.
